scenarios.scenario: Inspect a recent part's file properties after an informational notice

scenario_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software process starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
the disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native/Part23.opd` is displayed in List View
no Recent-file properties action has been requested in this process
the user chooses the part's document properties action and an informational notice is displayed
the user dismisses the informational notice
a file properties window for the part is displayed
its General page shows the file name, type, location, sizes, dates and attributes
the user dismisses the properties window
the Recent list is visible again

scenarios.scenario: Apply a type filter to a mixed selection

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
a recent part and a recent assembly are checked in List View
no other rows are checked and no recent-document filters are active
the user opens Filter and selects Part
the selected part remains checked and highlighted
the assembly is not displayed
Open Selected and Remove Selected remain displayed
the user clears the active filter
the part remains checked
the assembly is displayed again unchecked

scenarios.scenario: Sort recent rows by file size

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents with different known file sizes are displayed in List View
Last Opened is the active descending sort
the user selects the Size column header
the visible rows with known sizes are ordered from larger to smaller
the user selects the Size column header again
the visible rows with known sizes are ordered from smaller to larger

scenarios.scenario: Keep search and type filter when changing Recent views

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
a recent part named "Part26" is displayed in List View
the search for "Part26" and the Part filter are active
the user switches to Grid View
the search field contains "Part26"
the filter control indicates one active filter
the matching part is displayed as a card
the user switches back to List View
the search field still contains "Part26"
the filter control still indicates one active filter
the matching part is displayed as a row

scenarios.scenario: Reset Recent column settings after hiding Location

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents are displayed in List View
Location is displayed immediately after Name
the user opens Column Settings and clears Location
the Location column disappears
the user chooses Reset to default
Location is checked in Available Columns
Location is displayed immediately after Name again
Column Settings remains open
